info.title: Northline Motion Works Asset Condition API
info.description: Read-only condition data for fictional Riverbend drive assets. Replace the server URL with the facilitator-confirmed deployment before importing.

get.description: Get current readings, asset-specific thresholds, status, violations, and known issues for one DRIVE-101 through DRIVE-105 asset. Always call this operation for each requested asset.

parameters.name: asset_id
parameters.description: Stable asset ID, for example DRIVE-103
